posts.title: Herdr is amazing
posts.description: Herdr gave me one visible place to run agent teams across my desktop and phone.

posts.title: AI Actually Raises the Skill Floor - If You're Serious
posts.description: AI lowered the barrier to starting. It raised the floor for shipping. Three paths - full teams, guard systems, or enforcement by construction - all demand more cross-domain awareness, not less.

posts.title: AI Did the Work. That's Not the Point.
posts.description: I used AI to fix a phone system I barely understood. A chatbot arrived at the same diagnosis with the same data. The interesting part is what happened before the prompt.
